title: chore: upgrade Biome to 2.5.15 and drop the version pin
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Upgraded @biomejs/biome from 2.3.10 to 2.5.15 and removed the version pin from formatting instructions; docs and skills now use `npx @biomejs/biome check --write` so npx runs the repository's installed package rather than the unrelated `biome@0.3.3`. Reformatted 126 files for the new formatter, mostly tests, without intended behavior changes. Fixed new lint errors by adding explicit types to buttons on five app pages, closing a missing `` in OpenClaw, correcting three unsafe optional chains in tests, and changing one export order. Disabled `noSvgWithoutTitle` only for SVG files because the 79 logos are displayed through ``. The lockfile's root workspace entry for packages/sdk now matches its package version, 5.1.0-alpha.14. Repo-wide Biome errors fell from 184 to 165 with none newly introduced; warnings rose from 210 to 227 and do not fail CI.
